name: Haus Central
beschreibung:
Overview

The Haus Central is an apartment house right in the village centre of Serfaus in the Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis holiday region in the Tyrolean district of Landeck. The Greiter host family offers space for families and self-catering guests in twelve modern holiday apartments. Depending on their size, the apartments are suitable for two to six people and measure between around 42 and 85 square metres. According to the operator, the amenities include cable TV, free internet access and a spacious kitchen-living room with a ceramic hob, extractor hood, dishwasher and fridge-freezer. Bathroom/shower and WC are in separate rooms; bed linen, crockery and towels are provided, and cots are available on request.

History/Background

The house is run by Greiter Hermann GmbH; the apartment house is registered as the company's business purpose in the hospitality trade. The registered office of the trade licence is Dorfbahnstraße 49 in 6534 Serfaus, and the supervisory authority is the district authority of Landeck. As part of the Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis region, the house is located in a municipality that has made a name for itself beyond national borders as a car-free village and whose village centre is connected to the ski area by the underground Serfauser Dorfbahn.

Getting there

The Haus Central is located at Dorfbahnstraße 49 in the centre of Serfaus. According to the operator, guests may drive up to the front door; for the duration of their stay, a free parking space is available per apartment, and a garage space on request. Serfaus is a car-free municipality. The Serfauser Dorf-U-Bahn, an underground air-cushion railway towards the Komperdell ski area, is only around 50 metres away; the cable car to the ski area can be reached on foot in about five minutes. Ski buses and hiking buses run within the region, and the Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis tourist board provides information on arrival, parking and mobility.

Tips

The house includes a wellness area with a sauna, steam bath, Kneipp pool, fitness room and relaxation area, as well as its own children's playroom with table football and billiards. A restaurant is located directly in the house and is open in summer with an outdoor dining area. The nearest shopping facility is around a ten-minute walk away. For reservations, the team can be reached by telephone from 14:00 to 22:00. Check-in is generally possible from 16:00 on the day of arrival, and check-out is by 10:00. Children from zero to five years stay free of charge; from six years, 40 euros per person per day is charged. Pets are welcome (15 euros per day); guests should bring their own blanket or basket.

Best time to travel

Serfaus is a year-round destination: in winter the focus is on the Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis ski area with the Serfauser Dorfbahn as a feeder, while in summer hiking, mountain biking and the surrounding mountain world invite you to stay. According to the operator, Haus Central is open in both summer and winter.
